purpose: Confirm or reject a preliminary joint-view amplification observation; no optimization
noise_seed: 61000 + task*100 + initial + noise_id*100000; explicit shared noise across all conditions/textures per key
primary_action_subset: first five execution actions, three translation coordinates

exploratory_broad_mechanism_gate.amplification: MR amplification >1.1 in at least 2/3 noises for at least 5/6 states
exploratory_broad_mechanism_gate.specificity: median MR interaction RMS at least 1.25 times each matched random control
exploratory_broad_mechanism_gate.limitations: Heuristic screening, not statistical significance or a novelty claim; no case selection

target_data_policy: These six target states are exploratory and cannot be reused as untouched test states for a future selected method. No texture is trained or selected from these results.
